title: Lichen: Leveraging Coupled Heterogeneity
problem: Heterogeneous-ISA CMPs use coarse-grained uniform program phases, missing optimization across multiple heterogeneity dimensions
motivation: Heterogeneous architectures promising for energy; ISA heterogeneity emerging; need fine-grained phase scheduling
method: Lichen: dynamic morphing between ISA cores and execution modes (in-order/out-of-order); CART ML algorithm predicts optimal phase
key_novelty: Fine-grained heterogeneous-ISA scheduling via dynamic morphing with 85.44%/91.35% prediction accuracy
